memories.content: ORGBRAIN_API_URL is the canonical API endpoint variable; ORGBRAIN_API_BASE is only a compatibility alias.
The Stop hook sends one batch capture request and does not perform tool discovery.
Credentials are never stored. Personal sensitive memory is denied unless restricted_7d has allowed principals.
Facts expire after 90 days; preferences and pitfalls expire after 180 days; restricted data expires within seven days.
Business categories are derived only from explicit project metadata and work type defaults to other.
An inferred decision blocks only at confidence 0.90 or higher with a reason, exact scope, current validity, no conflict, and durable evidence.
Memory repair is dry-run by default, requires a private backup or D1 export for apply, and suppresses rather than physically deletes.
Hybrid v4 retrieval passes semantic hits, atomic/profile/timeline/segment candidates, and BGE reranker scores into fusion.
The memory list API uses a stable cursor; full pages allow 100 items and compact pages allow 500 items.
The harness needs no memory JSON envelope. Conclusion becomes candidates, Evidence becomes references, and Gaps lowers confidence.
